column1: # Ronald (11-04): "Art's picks": installed honey_fungus (A), chanterelle (A), porcini (B, the two ceps), bracket_fungus_top and _side.
# Don't re-cut: a few magenta-tinged edge pixels were recoloured by hand after cutting.
# Mushrooms for Plants' vegetation layers: row a my picks, row b alternatives and the bracket's edge. All untinted.
# BLOCK_LIKE=<worktree>/notes/blocks/refs/mushroom_brown.png,<worktree>/notes/blocks/refs/mushroom_red.png,log_oak (Plants' approved mushrooms, from its sequoia branch)
# bracket_fungus is a small box on bark (about 12 wide, 8 deep of 16): its top and side each fill the whole square, for a full-square UV on that face.

column3: honey_fungus|plant|Honey fungus: a tight cluster of 6-7 small honey-brown mushroom caps (#6a4420 #9a6a30 #c8964a #e0b868) with darker scaly centres, on thin pale cream stems (#d8c8a0) of different heights, growing from one point at the bottom edge, about 16 px tall
column4: chanterelle|plant|Chanterelles: three egg-yolk yellow funnel-shaped mushrooms (#b87a10 #e0a020 #f0c040 #f8dc78) with wavy upturned rims and faint ridges running down the stem, low to the ground, the biggest 10 px across and 12 px tall, standing on the bottom edge
column5: porcini_a@-|plant|Porcini (cep): one fat mushroom with a big bun-shaped glossy chestnut-brown cap (#4a2a14 #6e4224 #92603a #b4844e) 18 px across, its rim paler, on a very thick bulbous pale cream stem (#c8b890 #e0d4b0 #f0e8cc) with a faint white net pattern, about 18 px tall, standing on the bottom edge
column6: bracket_fungus_top|cutout|A bracket (hoof) fungus seen from straight above: a half disc filling the square's width, its flat edge along the bottom edge (where it grows from the bark) and its round edge reaching 4 px below the top edge, with 5-6 concentric ridged growth bands curving around the bottom middle, grey-brown and dark brown (#3e3428 #5a4c3c #7a6a56 #9a8a74) with a pale cream rim on the round outer edge (#d0c4a8); flat solid magenta outside the half disc

column3: honey_fungus_b@-|plant|Honey fungus: a cluster of 5 honey-yellow caps (#8a5a20 #b88038 #dcac58) of different sizes, flat with a small bump in the middle, on thin stems with a pale ring, rising from the bottom edge, about 14 px tall
column4: chanterelle_b@-|plant|Chanterelles: two golden-orange funnel mushrooms (#c07018 #e09a30 #f4c058), one tall and one short, with deep wavy rims and ridges under the cap, standing on the bottom edge, about 13 px tall
column5: porcini|plant|Porcini: two ceps, one big (bun-shaped brown cap #6e4224 #92603a #b4844e, 16 px across) and one small young button beside it, both on thick pale stems (#e0d4b0), standing on the bottom edge, about 16 px tall
column6: bracket_fungus_side|face|The edge of a bracket (hoof) fungus seen from the side, filling the whole square: thick horizontal ridged growth bands stacked from top to bottom, grey-brown and dark brown (#3e3428 #5a4c3c #7a6a56 #9a8a74), each band slightly overhanging the one below, the lowest band a pale cream rim (#d0c4a8 #e4dcc4), the band edges tiling left to right
